name: Hua Xia Bank Co., Limited
summary: Hua Xia Bank Co., Limited provides commercial banking services in China and Hong Kong. It offers current, time, corporate agreement, foreign currency, and notice deposit products; debit and credit services; housing loans, business loans, life loans, and personal loans, as well as working capital, credit, stock pledge, fixed asset, guarantee, and syndicate loans; financial services, such as trading, investment, foreign exchange, and third-party depositary; and fund products.
